Only clearer confirmation of that inference would make it stronger.

The 2-character minimum in app.js:313-317 is the one gratuitous validation rule; removing it would make the path strictly shorter.

A direct comparison of mobile role-guide placement would strengthen it further.

comparison: Candidate A has the more rigorous product and trade-off write-up and a very direct one-field path, while Candidate B is equally complete and visually stronger, with cleaner heading and control semantics. Both implement project-first onboarding, optional invitations, skip/resume and recoverable failure; Candidate B's mobile control overlap is offset by its zero-violation accessibility result and stronger typographic hierarchy.
limitations: Only initial-state screenshots were supplied, so invite, success, failure, limit and resume screens could not be visually assessed. Email delivery, backend behavior, screen readers, cross-browser rendering and the extra test transcripts referenced by both candidates were unavailable; prototype control overlays are demo chrome, which limits visual conclusions.
